verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt lists an official Model Context Protocol channel on its REST API, linked to a first-party developer page, that connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client. The evidence comes only from a summary index, though, so the server's depth is unproven. Missing for 10: MCP setup and auth documentation, a list of exposed tools/scopes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://developer.moneybird.com/tools/mcp): connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client.
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
